{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_duplicates = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"Total duplicate patient_id entries: {patient_duplicates}")

# Count how many times each patient_id appears
dup_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
dup_counts_above_1 = dup_counts[dup_counts > 1]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple entries: {len(dup_counts_above_1)}")
print(f"Sample of patients with multiple entries: {dup_counts_above_1.head().to_dict()}")

# Check sample_seq for these patients
multi_entry_patients = df[df['patient_id'].isin(dup_counts_above_1.index)]
print(f"Highest sample_seq per patient: {multi_entry_patients.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().to_dict()}")"}
